issues.detail: The Vietnamese adds 'đó' (that) to the object of the verb, which is not present in the Greek source. The Greek 'αστοχησαντες' is a participle modifying 'τινες' (some), not an object being abandoned.

The Vietnamese 'xây bỏ mục đích đó' (abandoned that purpose) misinterprets the participle 'αστοχησαντες' (having missed the mark / having failed). The Greek describes the state of the people (those who missed the mark) rather than an action they performed (abandoning a purpose).
